title: Exclude seven-call shared-hub interleaving without an exponent-relation limit
body:
**Scoped negative result: seven nonzero shared-hub calls still require two triple blocks, even with one repeated projector and no exponent-relation limit.** Over every torsion-free paid-generated exponent group, a diagonal endpoint has targets `(S,S,S+T,T,T)`, where each triple has a common exact type total. The targets use disjoint paid subsets, so this class has no rational paid-rank saving. **No new kappa** follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/PROOF.md), [complete order certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/CREDITS.md). This resolves the repeated-call question in [PR #7742](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7742), and includes its requested five-relation case.

At the first nonzero augmentation degree, the two repeated coefficients are equal, independent, or exactly one vanishes. The cross-commutator lemma excludes separation in the first two cases. The last case leaves a visible six-call core in two blocks. An exact private-input/output rectangle excludes inserting the extra call inside a proper opposite prefix; explicit three-coordinate identities exclude placing it beyond the complete opposite block. All three projector types and their reflected B counterparts are covered. The repeated labels then combine to the prior six-call theorem.

| Initial forms of the repeated calls | Passing first-mixed orders | Passing orders with a separator |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Equal, both nonzero | 2,016 | 0 |
| Independent | 288 | 0 |
| First zero | 504 | 216 |
| Second zero | 504 | 216 |

The exact cuts resolve the 216 exceptions in each last row. All 20,160 leading-form order checks and 511 commutator subsets pass. Full Laurent multiplication covers 393,120 words across all six repeated types, seven rank-two fixtures and six rank-one fixtures. Exactly 22,464 endpoints are diagonal, all with the predicted entries. A separate bivariate set engine checks 468 full products. Symbolic cut identities, six prefix-rank checks and controls for an even repeated label, an even type-total change and a missing hub contribution pass. The source six-call verifier runs unchanged on all 527,040 cases.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-hub-seven-call
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_SHARED_HUB_SEVEN_CALL
4 complete leading-form cases; 20160 order checks; 511 commutator subsets
393120 full Laurent words; 22464 diagonal endpoints; 468 independent sparse products
All three repeated projector types and both triples; exact exceptional cuts and controls
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44432409254/job/135252816606) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the [six-call theorem and question](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9394615e9fd3a30b66e23d422da4945258d7923f/research/shared-hub-single-pass/README.md) and [unchanged checker](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9394615e9fd3a30b66e23d422da4945258d7923f/research/shared-hub-single-pass/verify.py). Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the [pool](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/57e24923b609d2588b83321f530fa2a1e75ed364/research/edge-matching-even-attainment/PROOF.md) in [PR #7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707) and the [cross-commutator lemma](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ac185e4529a01156f7b574555b50827f8cb645bb/research/shared-hub-triple-word-obstruction/PROOF.md) in [PR #7711](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7711). Jerry Jiaheng Chen (@CubeJerry) supplied the [augmentation chronology method](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/685457252b51b9c7932ece363365bdf0b12c9c31/research/bit-three-relation-core/FIVE-CORE-WORD.md) in [PR #6782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6782).

The arbitrary-label claim is the written proof; the finite fixtures do not enumerate every saturated lattice. Eight or more calls, changed projector pools, arbitrary register changes, native realization, physical storage/restoration and the complete caller invoice remain open. The full PR7711 and geometry suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No global literature priority or independent human/formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.
